# Wayfair UK

> > Wayfair UK is an online marketplace for furniture, lighting, homeware, and home decor, offering both a retail shopping platform and supplier partnership programs.

Wayfair UK operates as both a consumer-facing ecommerce platform featuring brands like 17 Stories, Trent Austin Design, and Dakota Fields, and a B2B marketplace through its CastleGate fulfillment program. The site serves customers looking for home goods while also providing onboarding resources for suppliers wanting to sell through the Wayfair marketplace.
